affected.note: Customers of the gift and catalog order system. 330 records also included email addresses. Card data, e-money and point card data were not included. Several other retailers using GR's Omni EC system were affected by the same intrusion.

summary.en: Yamaguchi supermarket chain Marukyu said a shared server of its contractor GR, which ran its gift and catalog order system, was accessed without authorization. Names, phone numbers and addresses of 25,693 customers may have leaked.
summary.ja: 山口県でスーパーを展開する丸久は、ギフト・カタログ注文システムを運営する委託先ジーアールの共用サーバーが第三者の不正アクセスを受けたと公表した。顧客25,693件の氏名、電話番号、住所などが流出した可能性がある。
